- New weather system, (rain, snow, hail, sleet, good weather)
- Minor fixes in game code for various parts of the game.

Still developging:

- Build Grid, placement of structures incuding modular houses are easy to do using a 3D grid.
- Desert houses also.

notes.title: Update 2016-08-11
notes.notes:
Finally a major update released. Alot of improvements done and new features added. It toke a little longer because it change a several parts of the game. Heres a list of the pricipal ones:

-Added Flying Birds to Forest, Rock Mountains, Ice Mountains, and you can kill the birds by pressing with the mouse on them :P
-Minimap now doesnt rotate, got arrow that display player forward direction.
-Framerate improved a little bit, still not the best but a little better.
-Added dozens of new trees
-Added eleven new Houses, can be placed near the water.
-Sound Fx of levels changed.
-Sandstorm added to desert map.
-Wind added, now branches moving in the wind.
-Added leaves falling from trees flying with the wind. 
-Added diverse new plants for desert map.
-Desert Cactus give water.
-Pickaxe and Axe sounds changed.
-Rocks pickup with pickaxe changed, rocks now got a disapearing effect.
-Trees got sound fx when falling after been cutted.
-AI and movemnet of animals improved a little.
-Torch now on left side, and can be used at the same time with axe or pickaxe.
-Highlight of objects now is a little bit harder to focus, need to search passing the mouse over the object, and also the color changed to transparent brown. 
-If objects is highlighted and press "k" the edit menu will appear to move, rotate or scale object. (Note: the Trees and rocks that already exists on map cannot be edited, only the ones places by build menu.)
-Trees and Rocks of map can be premanently removed if highlighted and mouse button pressed.
-Terrain generation tunned to be faster than before, it freezes a little the game when generating a new set of terrains, is this way to be able to erase the old and create the new terrain. 
-Campfires and torches give more light.
-Sword kill enemies, is a little difficult to killed them, need to insist until they die, but you dont die so the best for now until i improve the fighting part of game is placing enemies and allies fighting each other, on the build menu can find these characters.
-In GOD mode by press "g" you can fly around, also now if you build and object you dont need resources, it will apear built.
-Added key to disable the UI. Press "F2" key to enable/disable the UI to better take screenshots of the landscape.
-Save game changed and improved to include ocean map. Previous saves wont work, you need to delete them. 
-Added Ocean Map, where can be entered by clicking in the ocean part on the Map Menu, you will be transported inside a ship, to use the ship go to the steer and press "T", then with the WASD keys can drive the ship in the sea. There are islands also, by pressing "t" again you stop steering, to get out of the ship and visit the island you find use GOD mode, for now is the only way to get in and out of the ship. The island are terrains like in the other maps, also can use the same functions to build/edit as the other maps.
-5 types of ships, galleon, raft, pirate ship, rowboat and viking boat, the galleon and pirate ship are the same but the sails texture change. The Galleon and pirate ship have doors to go below to the cannons and other to go below the ster in a room that gives acess to the rear balcany. The rowboat and viking boat have rowing animation. There are still work to be done in the ships, two more rooms need to be modeled, and also putting the cannons to fire. All five ships can be placed in the ocean and can drive them. 
NOTE WARNING place ship only on Ocean map, because the water is diferent, it will not float on the other maps.
-In the ocean there are wales sharks and other creatures, they wont attack you for now they are only wandering the ocean, still work in progress.
-Bug, some times you fall through the ground, if this occur wait a moment falling, after a while the character appear on the ground again. Need still to get a better fix for this. 
-Build menu object preview small fix
-Egyptian statues added

I want to thanks all who support, comment and give ideas to this game. And to all that bought this game i hope to not disapoint. I will continue to update regulary.

Anyone that like to comment, give ideas or report game bugs please do so, it will help the development alot.

Hope you enjoy :D

notes.title: UPDATE 08/05/2016
notes.notes:
- Added 17 types of fish
- You can find fish swimming in any water in some depth.
- You can catch fish using a spear.
- Fish caught are added to the inventory.
- You can throw the fish out of the inventory and come back to get them.
- Fish caught are edible, and reduce hunger.


I will add more content and features soon.

Who bought the game and those who buy, beg you to to post comments and ideas for the game, I know the game has glitches and bugs, but what I need is some support to develop this game using your comments. If you want to help the game, then post your ideas. Thank you.

Have fun. ːsteamhappyː

notes.notes:

DO NOT BUY THIS GAME IF YOU FEEL IS NOT YET THE RIGHT TIME. THANK YOU

UPDATE 04/25/2016

-The Water looks more real, with deep water effect. The image appears distorted and blue to give the idea that we are in water

-Added Beggars characters that will in a future update will be used to train archers, wizards, warriors and also farmers and workers.

-The Structures are now destroyed if attacked, among the rubble can be recovered wood and stone. to recover it using the build command: choose "Delete Object". And click the right mouse button.

-The Friendly characters can be ordered to stay in a place or follow you.

-Fix save bug that constructed structures didn't apear built after saving and reloading gamesave.

Have fun ːsteamhappyː
